description: P1 regression: absence of a 30-day receipt cannot distinguish never-admitted from completed-then-purged. Only a fresh web pending row with trusted created_at and successful peek(None) can be resubmitted under the SAME key. A read never invokes the model.
source_of_truth: Immutable server-generated thread_messages.created_at; core ExecutionStore.peek(owner,key), never client-supplied timestamps or age-based inference of ambiguous.

cases.name: completed-receipt-purged-at-day-31
cases.history: Core completed once and its receipt was purged after the 30-day retention; web TX2 crashed before durable snapshot

cases.name: fresh-pending-with-verified-no-receipt
cases.history: Web stored request; core claim has not happened

cases.name: pending-exactly-at-seven-day-boundary
cases.history: At retry window boundary, do not assume this execution never occurred
